sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
seg = current_frame.segmentation
nodes = seg['nodes']

# Collect all 7 green blocks
green_nodes = [n for n in nodes if n['color'] == 'N']
targets = [(sum([p[0] for p in n['boundary']])//len(n['boundary']), 
            sum([p[1] for p in n['boundary']])//len(n['boundary'])) for n in green_nodes]
result = action([{'action': 'MOUSE', 'row': r, 'col': c} for r, c in targets], intent='solve')
print(f"After 7 MOUSE: done={result.get('done')}, level_completed={result.get('level_completed')}")

# Check sky blue regions
seg = current_frame.segmentation
nodes = seg['nodes']
blue_nodes = [n for n in nodes if n['color'] == 'S']
print(f"\nSky blue objects: {len(blue_nodes)}")
for n in blue_nodes:
    print(f"  pixels={n['pixels']}, boundary={n['boundary'][:4]}")

# Try MOUSE on sky blue region
if blue_nodes:
    bn = blue_nodes[0]
    boundary = bn['boundary']
    rows = [p[0] for p in boundary]
    cols = [p[1] for p in boundary]
    center_row = sum(rows) // len(rows)
    center_col = sum(cols) // len(cols)
    print(f"\nTrying MOUSE on sky blue center=({center_row}, {center_col})")
    result = action([{'action': 'MOUSE', 'row': center_row, 'col': center_col}], intent='solve')
    print(f"Result: done={result.get('done')}, level_completed={result.get('level_completed')}")
    
    # Check what changed
    seg = current_frame.segmentation
    nodes = seg['nodes']
    colors = {}
    for n in nodes:
        colors[n['color']] = colors.get(n['color'], 0) + 1
    print(f"Color counts: {colors}")
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
